observations.title: User skepticism → live proof pattern
observations.content:
**What**: User challenged claims (
o te creo) — responded with live tool demonstrations instead of arguments
**Why**: Trust is built with evidence, not rhetoric. Showing tool outputs in real-time beat any explanation
**Where**: This session, gentleman-agent-gh project
**Learned**: When user doubts capabilities → immediately run 3+ real tool calls and show raw results. Don't argue, demonstrate. Pattern: claim → evidence → verification

observations.title: score-cache.json optimization — 99.8% reduction
observations.content:
**What**: Optimized score-cache.json from 155 lines/81KB to 9 lines/133 bytes
**Why**: Cache was storing full base64-encoded composite hash (61K chars) + complete result object (duplicated in .project.json)
**Where**: scripts/score-auto.ps1 (lines 64-67 hash generation, 245-255 cache save), scripts/perf-offline-fallback.ps1 (lines 90-101 cache read), .learnings/score-cache.json
**Learned**: ConvertFrom-Json parses ISO timestamps as DateTime — use .ToString() before .Substring(); Get-FileHash -InputStream works for hashing strings without temp files; Backward compat v1+v2
